title: Autoscaling for Virtual Network Data Gateway (Preview)

content.text: Autoscaling for Virtual Network Data Gateway (Preview) automatically adjusts the number of active gateway nodes within admin-defined minimum and maximum limits based on workload demand, so the gateway absorbs spikes without manual intervention and scales down to reduce cost during idle periods.
